source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just (accidently) did 2 mints.
The first i referred to #5 with a $1 tip but the tip didn't work - 0x0eab3ba1e91f99ac6e86793487046e3632f735c6661abff6c8e33800abc6559e

The second, i did with no referral code, but still no ticket and commission are showing on the leaderboard for it - 0xfd5bd846b2543da486211a72fcecd178be8a3bee966b34823636648e897bf9ea

execution.observed_behavior: A mint using referral code 5 with a selected $1 tip completed without the tip working.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just minted using 'no referral code' and giving a '$1 tip'.

\- Tipping isn't working.

\- Tickets and commissions from 'no referral code' buys still aren't showing up on the leaderboard or in the NFT attributes

also, after i minted, another transaction (shown in screenshot) popped up, but i cancelled it and the mint worked fine.
Do you know why this second transaction appeared, was that for the tip?

execution.observed_behavior: A selected $1 tip was not sent; an unexplained follow-up transaction appeared after the mint and was canceled while the mint itself still succeeded.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Why your tip “isn’t working.”
Tips in our app are a separate USDC transfer transaction from your wallet to founderWallet after mint. If you cancel that second tip transaction, the mint still succeeds (exactly what you observed), but the tip won’t be sent.
Also, right now the “auto” follow-up behavior is confusing: for no-referral mints, there can be a different “Step 2” tx (finalize random referral), which also can pop up.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that a tip is implemented as a separate USDC transfer to the founder wallet after minting, and canceling that transaction prevents the tip without canceling the mint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
okay, i just minted with 'no referral code' and a '$1 tip'.

I had to execute 1 transaction to mint - 0xc92e17e9e7f26e6b4e03093ce35f6ed3d7fc135c8ee00bc77357eb082779f715

And then another transaction immediately appeared for the tip - 0x887c21856bddc283cd444881931a1d14469cbbd49c2c2764e15855a9181af3b0

(We will have to put a UI note so that buyers know the tip transaction will come immediately after the mint transaction.)

Also, Perhaps it was hidden behind the tip transaction, but i didn't see the 'mint successful' modal.

And, on the leaderboard, there was no new commission and ticket counted.

value_updates.follow_up_transaction_notice: Tell buyers that the tip is sent through an immediate second transaction after the mint transaction.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The tip worked, but it needs a UI note so that people know the tip is sent in an immediate second transaction.
Otherwise they might think they are about to buy a second copy

execution.observed_behavior: Client confirms that the tip transfer worked through the immediate second transaction.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
One more important note from your case
Your “$1 tip” tx ended up as a self-transfer because the on-chain founderWallet is currently your wallet, so tipping yourself doesn’t move funds. I deployed a UI safeguard to disable tips in that case.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports deploying a UI safeguard that disables tipping when the connected wallet is also the founder wallet, preventing a meaningless self-transfer.
